blocks.prompt: 20. If \(a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots, a_n\) are positive and in A.P., prove that \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{a_1} + \sqrt{a_2}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{a_2} + \sqrt{a_3}} + \cdots + \frac{1}{\sqrt{a_{n-1}} + \sqrt{a_n}} = \frac{n - 1}{\sqrt{a_1} + \sqrt{a_n}}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh lamba sa jama (sum) dikhta hai, lekin chaal ek hi hai. Har fraction ke neeche do square roots ka jama hai.
Har fraction ko rationalise karein to us ka neeche wala hissa \(d\) ban jata hai, aur phir poora jama simat jata hai (telescoping: beech ki terms cancel).
Plan: ek aam term ko rationalise karna, sab ko jama karna, phir jawab ki shakal mein lana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1, \ldots, a_n\) positive hain aur A.P. mein hain, common difference \(d\)
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \dfrac{n - 1}{\sqrt{a_1} + \sqrt{a_n}}\).
Tareeqa: Rationalise karna; A.P. ki do baatein use hongi: \(a_{r+1} - a_r = d\) aur \(a_n - a_1 = (n - 1)d\). Pehle \(d \ne 0\) lete hain; \(d = 0\) ko aakhir mein alag dekhenge. Positive hone ki shart is liye hai ke square roots real hon.

Ek aam term ko rationalise karein
\[\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{a_r} + \sqrt{a_{r+1}}}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{a_{r+1}} - \sqrt{a_r}}{a_{r+1} - a_r}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{a_{r+1}} - \sqrt{a_r}}{d}\]
Kyun: Upar neeche \(\sqrt{a_{r+1}} - \sqrt{a_r}\) (neeche wale ka conjugate) se multiply kiya. \((x + y)(y - x) = y^2 - x^2\) se neeche ke square roots khatam ho gaye. Phir A.P. mein do saath wali terms ka farq hamesha \(d\) hai, is liye har fraction ka neeche wala hissa ek hi number \(d\) ban gaya. Yehi is sawal ki chaabi hai.

Sab terms jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{d}\big[(\sqrt{a_2} - \sqrt{a_1}) + (\sqrt{a_3} - \sqrt{a_2})\]
\[+ \cdots + (\sqrt{a_n} - \sqrt{a_{n-1}})\big]\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{a_n} - \sqrt{a_1}}{d}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{a_2}\) ek dafa plus aur ek dafa minus aaya, \(\sqrt{a_3}\) bhi, aur isi tarah beech ke saare roots. Sab cancel ho gaye; sirf pehla \(-\sqrt{a_1}\) aur aakhri \(+\sqrt{a_n}\) bache. Jaise doorbeen (telescope) band hoti hai, waise hi yeh jama simat gaya.

Dobara rationalise karein
\[= \dfrac{a_n - a_1}{d(\sqrt{a_1} + \sqrt{a_n})}\]
Kyun: Jawab ke neeche \(\sqrt{a_1} + \sqrt{a_n}\) chahiye, is liye upar neeche isi se multiply kiya. Upar phir \(y^2 - x^2\) wala formula laga: \((\sqrt{a_n} - \sqrt{a_1})(\sqrt{a_n} + \sqrt{a_1}) = a_n - a_1\).

\(a_n - a_1 = (n - 1)d\) rakhein
\[= \dfrac{(n - 1)d}{d(\sqrt{a_1} + \sqrt{a_n})}\]
\[= \dfrac{n - 1}{\sqrt{a_1} + \sqrt{a_n}} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: General term se \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\), to \(a_n - a_1 = (n - 1)d\). Upar aur neeche ka \(d\) cancel ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: Fractions ki ginti \(n\) nahi, \(n - 1\) hai (har fraction do padosi terms ka jora hai); isi liye jawab mein \(n - 1\) aata hai.

\(d = 0\) wali soorat
\[\text{L.H.S.} = (n - 1) \cdot \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{a_1}} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(d = 0\) ho to saari terms barabar hain aur hum \(d\) se divide nahi kar sakte the, is liye alag dekha. \(n - 1\) barabar fractions, har ek \(\frac{1}{2\sqrt{a_1}}\); right side bhi \(\frac{n - 1}{2\sqrt{a_1}}\). Yani natija har haal mein sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: yeh jama \(\frac{n - 1}{\sqrt{a_1} + \sqrt{a_n}}\) ke barabar hai.
